screen_policy: Every slide must prove the exact copy through visible Aachu/Zuv behavior. Any doubtful slide blocks image generation until repaired and re-reviewed.

slide_reviews.copy:
We’re not married yet.
But try telling that to our habits.

Every plan starts with:
“Ek minute, usse poochna padega.”

Every small decision becomes
a two-person meeting.

Then five minutes later:
“Ghar pahunch ke text karna.”

Shaadi abhi baaki hai.
Par “hum” toh kab ke ban chuke hain.

director_storyboard.physical_event: Three recognition beats give way to a snapped key, a joint repair attempt, an argument, departure, indirect key placement, a tissue dabbed onto a thumb nick, and a next-morning repaired-lock exit.
director_storyboard.emotional_arc: Unspoken teamwork becomes shared stress, equal friction, reluctant distance, care that survives anger, and restored everyday rhythm.
director_storyboard.relationship_change: The couple does not acquire a new bond; the incident proves that an existing ‘us’ persists through anger and resumes after repair.
director_storyboard.sequence_read: The copy-hidden critic inferred the broken-key event, cooperation-to-friction-to-care turn, and final return from separation into shared rhythm from observable cards alone.
